Rozare message gallery

Approved 12 October 2026. Email, fixed WhatsApp, web/mobile inbox and push previews. New shows the approved source version; Old uses verified source history. All examples use dummy data. Deployment status is reported separately in the chat.

Coverage and preview limitations

Source-backed local previews with dummy data. 13 notification producer families, 54 producer call sites and 36 direct WhatsApp send sites are accounted for. This is a message inventory, not proof of live delivery.

  • Backend/services/financialNotificationOutboxService.js — Order receipts/lifecycle, seller fulfillment, COD decisions, return settlement, Wallet credit/debit, all withdrawal states
  • Backend/services/buyerCancellationService.js — Buyer/seller COD, Wallet, original-card pending/completed and unsupported-rail review
  • Backend/services/safepayRefundService.js — Buyer/seller verified card refund
  • Backend/services/safepaySafetyRefundService.js — Admin refund not-submitted / reconciliation
  • Backend/services/cancellationRefundService.js — Admin cancellation refund review
  • Backend/services/safepayBillingService.js — Trial/active/failed operation
  • Backend/services/safepayBillingLifecycleService.js — Cancel/resume/downgrade/cancel downgrade/ended and in-flight cancellation
  • Backend/services/subscriptionLifecycleNotificationService.js — Shared trial/bonus and Safepay ending warnings, plus retained Stripe-only plan/invoice activation labelled separately
  • Backend/services/returnNotificationService.js — New request, buyer cancellation, all non-settlement status labels
  • Backend/services/sellerOperationalNotificationService.js — Seller welcome, store-created moderation states, verification decisions, rating, payout update, product blocked
  • Backend/services/catalogModerationNotificationService.js — Store/product approved and blocked; pending is inapp/push-only and is not fabricated as email/WhatsApp
  • Backend/services/safepaySubdomainService.js — Current Safepay ownership receipt
  • Backend/services/subdomainLifecycleNotificationService.js — Ownership expired and removed

AI-generated conversations are not fixed templates. In-app and push tabs show source-authored notification text, not a screenshot of a running app. Original-account Raast refund review samples are exceptions, not normal Wallet cancellations. Retained Stripe-specific risk/cleanup producers are excluded from active Safepay previews.

Old comparisons are read from pinned Git history where a matching source definition exists. New is the approved source version. Deployment and delivery status are reported separately in the chat. This gallery sends no messages.
